电话那头安静了一秒。

林川攥着手机，声音压低了半度：“伤得重不重？”

“不算严重，手背有点擦伤，其他没什么大问题。”陈知语的语气带着明显的为难，“但对方家长已经到了，情绪比较激动，系里老师也在，我想还是请您过来一趟。”

“人在哪？”

“行政楼二楼，辅导员办公室。”

“十五分钟到。”

林川挂了电话，没有直接下楼。

他先拨了叶知秋的号。

响了一声就接了。叶知秋这个点还在公司，电话那头能听到键盘声。

“知秋，法务部谁在？”

“赵律师今天加班，还没走。”

“带上他，行政楼下等我，五分钟。”

叶知秋没问为什么，应了一声就挂了。

林川从椅子上站起来，拿起外套，走到门口的时候停了一步，把桌上那份企业家提名材料翻过去扣在桌面上。

脑子里只有一个念头——

小冉在学校被人欺负了。

谁他妈碰的。

电梯门开的时候，叶知秋已经站在一楼大堂了。她换了双平底鞋，手里拎着公文包，旁边站着赵律师，三十出头，西装领带，手里夹着一个黑色文件夹和一支笔。

两个人看见林川出来，异口同声的说：“林总。”

“上车”。

车子发动的时候，叶知秋从后视镜里看了林川一眼。他的脸沉着，下颌线绷得很紧，眼睛直直看着前方。

她跟了林川这么久，第一次看见他这个表情。

车里安静了大半程，快到上财校门口的时候，林川开口了，声音不大，但每个字都很清楚。

“我妹妹在学校跟人打架了，到了先把事情弄清楚。”

叶知秋手指顿了一下，随后点了下头，赵律师翻开文件夹，把空白页备好。

行政楼二楼，辅导员办公室的门虚掩着，里面的声音隔着走廊都能听到。

一个中年女人的嗓门又尖又亮，像是已经吵了很久还没消停：“我女儿脸都肿了！鼻子还在流血！你们学校就是这么管学生的？”

陈知语的声音夹在中间，语气克制但明显有点疲惫：“家长，我们正在了解情况，您先坐——”

“坐什么坐！我女儿被人打成这样，你让我坐着等？”

林川推开门的那一瞬间，屋子里所有声音同时停了。

不是因为他一个人。

是因为他身后还跟着两个人。

叶知秋穿着黑色的职业套装，头发扎得利落，手里拎着公文包，目光扫过房间里所有人的脸，不急不慢地站到林川右后方半步的位置。

赵律师更安静，直接在门边找了把椅子坐下，打开文件夹，笔尖搁在纸上，像是随时准备记录什么。

这阵仗，不像是来接孩子的。

房间里的人明显愣了一拍。

陈知语坐在办公桌后面，旁边还有一个系里的年轻老师。

对面沙发上坐着一个中年女人，烫着大波浪，指甲做得鲜红，妆化得浓，嘴角往下耷拉着，一脸“我女儿吃了天大的亏”的表情。

她旁边坐着个女孩，跟林小冉差不多大，右眼眶一圈青紫，鼻孔塞着纸巾，嘴还是撅着的，一脸不服。

林川的视线没在她们身上停。

他看向角落。

林小冉坐在最靠墙的那把椅子上，头发有点散，校服袖口皱了。

她右手手背上有两道红色的抓痕，不深，但看着扎眼。

眼眶微红，不是在哭，是气的。

她看见林川进来，嘴唇动了一下。

There was silence on the other end of the phone for a second.

Lin Chuan clutched the phone and lowered his voice by half a degree: "Is the injury serious?"

"It's not serious. The back of my hand is a little scratched. There are no other major problems." Chen Zhiyu said with obvious embarrassment in his tone, "But the other party's parents are already here and they are quite excited. The teachers in the department are also here. I think it's better to ask you to come over."

"Where is the person?"

"Second floor of the administration building, counselor's office."

"We'll be there in fifteen minutes."

Lin Chuan hung up the phone and did not go downstairs directly.

He first dialed Ye Zhiqiu's number.

Answered as soon as it rang.Ye Zhiqiu was still at the company at this point, and the sound of the keyboard could be heard on the other end of the phone.

"Zhiqiu, who is in the legal department?"

"Lawyer Zhao is working overtime today and hasn't left yet."

"Take him with you and wait for me downstairs in five minutes."

Ye Zhiqiu didn't ask why, just answered and hung up.

Lin Chuan stood up from the chair, picked up his coat, stopped for a step when he walked to the door, turned over the entrepreneur nomination materials on the table and clasped them on the table.

There is only one thought in my mind——

Xiaoran was bullied at school.

Who the hell touched it.

When the elevator door opened, Ye Zhiqiu was already standing in the lobby on the first floor.She changed into a pair of flat shoes and carried a briefcase in her hand. Next to her stood lawyer Zhao, who was in his early thirties, wearing a suit and tie, holding a black folder and a pen in his hand.

When the two people saw Lin Chuan coming out, they said in unison: "Mr. Lin."

"Get in the car".

When the car started, Ye Zhiqiu glanced at Lin Chuan in the rearview mirror.His face was stern, his jawline was tight, and his eyes were looking straight ahead.

After following Lin Chuan for so long, this was the first time she saw his expression.

The car was quiet for most of the journey. When he was approaching the gate of the Finance School, Lin Chuan spoke. His voice was not loud, but every word was clear.

"My sister got into a fight with someone at school. Let's figure it out first when we get there."

Ye Zhiqiu paused with his fingers, then nodded. Lawyer Zhao opened the folder and prepared the blank pages.

On the second floor of the administration building, the door to the counselor's office was ajar, and the sounds inside could be heard across the corridor.

A middle-aged woman's voice was high-pitched and loud, as if the quarrel had been going on for a long time and had not subsided: "My daughter's face is swollen! Her nose is still bleeding! Is this how your school controls students?"

Chen Zhiyu's voice was caught in the middle, his tone was restrained but obviously a little tired: "Parents, we are understanding the situation, please sit down first -"

"Why sit down? My daughter was beaten like this, and you want me to sit down and wait?"

The moment Lin Chuan opened the door, all the sounds in the room stopped at the same time.

Not because of him alone.

It's because there are two people following him.

Ye Zhiqiu was wearing a black professional suit, his hair was neatly tied, and he was holding a briefcase in his hand. He glanced at the faces of everyone in the room and stood half a step behind Lin Chuan's right.

Lawyer Zhao was quieter. He found a chair by the door and sat down. He opened the folder and placed the tip of his pen on the paper, as if he was ready to record something at any time.

This battle doesn't look like they are here to pick up a child.

The people in the room were obviously stunned for a moment.

Chen Zhiyu was sitting behind his desk, with a young teacher from the department beside him.

Sitting on the sofa opposite was a middle-aged woman with wavy perm, bright red nails, heavy makeup, drooped corners of her mouth, and an expression on her face that said, "My daughter has suffered a huge loss."

There was a girl sitting next to her, about the same age as Lin Xiaoran, with a purple circle around her right eye, a tissue stuffed in her nostrils, and her mouth was still pouted, with a look of dissatisfaction.

Lin Chuan's eyes did not stop on them.

He looked around the corner.

Lin Xiaoran was sitting on the chair closest to the wall. Her hair was a little disheveled and the cuffs of her school uniform were wrinkled.

There were two red scratches on the back of her right hand. They were not deep, but they looked glaring.

Her eyes were slightly red, not because she was crying, but because she was angry.

When she saw Lin Chuan coming in, her lips moved.
